# Inserting a New Arrived Book

#### Course: Learn SQL Basics

## Inserting a New Arrived Book

The team approaches you, saying, "A new book has arrived at the store: "Brave New World" by Aldous Huxley, categorized as Dystopian and published in 1932. How can you add this book to the Books table?"

You can use the INSERT INTO statement to add the new book to the database.

```sql
1INSERT INTO Books (id, title, author, genre, year_published, availability) 
2VALUES (7, 'Brave New World', 'Aldous Huxley', 'Dystopian', 1932, 'Yes');
```

The above query inserts the details of the Brave New World book into the Books table.
